prompt_text:
Storybook ink and gouache, dark contours, slightly realistic, fully painted to the edges, 16:9. Eye-level view inside the science faculty hall: pale tan stone walls, cream floor, glass roof with the telescope's iron gantry seen through the glass, cool daylight, true colors. The attached picture is this building from outside. Match its tan stone, glass roof, telescope, and glass doors. Do not copy its aerial viewpoint.

Back center: open glass doors onto a gravel path and autumn trees. The view looks out. It is not a picture of this building's own front. The threshold is clear.

A geologist has just come back from the field.

Mid-left, the sack and cart stay a clear distance in from the left edge: a wooden hand-cart carries a torn burlap sack of dark earth. Soil spills from the rip. One seedling grows from the tear.

In front of the cart: one solid rectangular building stone, flat sawn faces, no hole, no window, no door, and not a kiln. Next to the stone is a shallow oval pan of blue water. Standing in that water is a small wooden pier, a short jetty: planks on posts that go down into the water, one end touching the stone. It is not a table. Nothing holds it up from the dry floor.

Back left, on a low table: one small mine model only. One rock tunnel, one lantern, one ore cart on rails. No wheelbarrow and no second cart.

Center, on its own low round table: a sparkling mineral cluster under a desk lamp, with a small rainbow on the cluster.

Right foreground: one adult man sits on a bench. He tilts one rubber boot so the sole's tread rests in a tray of dark soil. One worm lifts its head from that soil. His whole body stays in this right-hand group.

Back right, separated from the man by a wide stretch of open floor: a tall purple crystal on a wooden stand. One mouse sits against the crystal and touches its base. The mouse is not on a stool. There is no cat and no other animal in the room.

No letters. No other people. Keep every object and the man well inside the picture, with open floor between the man and the crystal.
